title: The Social Viral Downloader WordPress plugin through 2.0.3 does not have authorisation or nonce checks on a log export…
description: The Social Viral Downloader WordPress plugin versions up to 2.0.3 lack authorization and nonce checks on a log export feature accessible to unauthenticated users. This vulnerability allows attackers to export the download log, which contains registered users' email addresses and IP addresses, to a publicly accessible file.
